text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sometime after the Yasuda Kinen, Hishi Akebono tells me she's been feeling a strange sensation in her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A test reveals that this is the result of chronic stress. After bearing her large physique through so many races, her joints are starting to give.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I worry about her future and recommend she slim down and change her running style, as to protect her knees and prolong her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Hishi Akebono isn't convinced by the new plan. She knows all her fans have come to know and love her for her massive size.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, Hishi Akebono asks for me to wait three months until the Sprinters S. is over before she makes her decision.
